headline: Record book value per share masks a sharp earnings pullback
summary_short: Assured Guaranty's Q2 2026 net income was $39M ($0.88 diluted EPS), down from $103M ($2.08) a year ago mainly on last year's $71M FX remeasurement gain versus a $2M loss now; adjusted operating income still rose to $55M from $50M, and per-share equity, adjusted operating equity, and ABV all hit record highs.
summary_long: GAAP net income fell to $39M ($0.88 diluted EPS) from $103M ($2.08) in Q2 2025, mainly because last year included a $71M FX remeasurement gain versus a $2M loss now. Adjusted operating income rose to $55M from $50M on $22M lower loss expense and $14M higher earned premiums, partly offset by $12M of CLO-related investment losses. First-half GWP and PVP grew 26% and 48% y/y. The company returned $62M to shareholders (buybacks $45M, dividends $17M) and reached per-share record highs in equity ($126.18), adjusted operating equity ($129.94), and ABV ($189.72). No numeric forward guidance was given.

drivers.explanation: Total revenues fell to $195M from $281M y/y almost entirely due to foreign-exchange remeasurement swinging from a $71M gain to a $2M loss, partly offset by $14M higher net earned premiums and credit derivative revenues.
Basic EPS fell to $0.88 from $2.10 y/y, tracking the net income decline to $39M from $103M, only partly cushioned by a smaller diluted share count (44.6M vs 49.4M) from continued buybacks.
Diluted EPS fell to $0.88 from $2.08 y/y on the same net income decline, with the roughly 10% smaller weighted diluted share count from share repurchases only partially offsetting the drop.

Pretax income fell to $49M from $133M y/y, driven by the FX remeasurement swing (a $71M gain in Q2 2025 versus a $2M loss now) and $12M of CLO equity mark-to-market losses in equity in earnings of investees.

Net income fell to $39M from $103M y/y primarily because last year's revenues included a $71M foreign-exchange remeasurement gain that did not recur; this quarter recorded a $2M FX remeasurement loss instead.
Total cash (incl. restricted) held roughly flat at $331M vs $333M q/q; the release attributes capital use to share repurchases ($45M) and dividends ($17M) paid during the quarter.
Long-term debt was essentially unchanged at $1,706M versus $1,705M q/q; the release does not disclose any new debt issuance or repayment activity this quarter.

Equity rose modestly to $5,559M from $5,542M q/q as net income and share repurchases were mostly offset by unrealized investment-portfolio losses and dividends, per the release's per-share equity walk.
Weighted diluted shares fell to 44.6M from 49.4M y/y as the Company repurchased $130M of stock (1.559M shares) during the first seven months of 2026, reducing the share count.

Q2 GAAP earnings fell sharply y/y on the absence of last year's FX remeasurement gain, but adjusted operating income rose to $55M from $50M and per-share equity, adjusted operating equity, and ABV all reached record highs, aided by first-half new-business growth (GWP +26%, PVP +48%) and $62M returned to shareholders.
